answers.how: The ring moves approximately 38 pixels in 4.958 seconds at a nearly constant speed. Its 58-pixel diameter represents 1 m, giving 38/(4.958×58) ≈ 0.132 m/s at 1.0 s.
The pool side measures approximately 364 pixels and the ring diameter approximately 58 pixels. Using the 1 m ring diameter gives 364/58 ≈ 6.3 m.
